card.name: Words before antidepressant risk claims
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "alone" after "antidepressant" in the bipolar-episode warning, and "about" after "conclusion" in the suicide-trial sentence. A few stray hits fall on unrelated words such as "see".

modes.label: Antidepressant alone
modes.description: The word "alone" right after "antidepressant" in the sentence on treating a possible bipolar episode.

modes.label: Conclusion about
modes.description: The word "about" after "conclusion" in the sentence about suicides in the trials.
modes.example: the number is too small to allow any conclusion<< about>> drug effect on suicide.

modes.label: Stray web hits
modes.description: Isolated hits on unrelated words in general web text, such as "see" in a reference line.

card.writes: It suppresses psychology and trauma words (mostly Chinese and English), so it steers the output away from psychological terms.
card.plain: It fires on a few words in antidepressant warning sentences and pushes the model away from psychology and trauma wording.
